To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cellulase enzymes can move on crystalline cellulose surfaces and that the efficiency of cellulase action can be increased by reducing the crystallinity of cellulose.

the cellulase enzyme TrCel7A moves unidirectionally on a crystalline cellulose substrate, and that the efficiency of this movement is enhanced by treatment with ammonia and by the synergistic activity with TrCel6A.
the hydrolytic efficiency of TrCel7A on crystalline cellulose is reduced by the formation of traffic jams, which can be alleviated by the addition of TrCel6A.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the mechanism of the enzymatic hydrolysis of cellulose, and we have revealed that the crystallinity and the surface accessibility of cellulose are the most important factors in determining the efficiency of cellulose hydrolysis.

the mechanism of cellulose degradation by cellulases and the synergism between cellulase enzymes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the hydrolytic efficiency of cellulase on crystalline cellulose is determined by the surface mobility of the enzyme molecules, and that the surface mobility is controlled by the accessibility of the cellulose surface and the presence of other enzyme molecules.

the hydrolytic efficiency of cellulase on cellulose surface can be improved by the increase in the number of lanes on the surface and the increase in the proportion and the number of mobile enzyme molecules, which can be achieved by the treatment of cellulose with ammonia and TrCel6A, respectively.
the cellulase enzymes can move more freely along the cellulose surface and that the hydrolytic efficiency is improved by the presence of a larger number of accessible sites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
traffic jams on cellulose surface are reduced by the synergistic effect between TrCel7A and TrCel6A, and the efficiency of cellulase is increased by the change of cellulose crystallinity.
traffic jams reduce the hydrolytic efficiency of cellulase on the cellulose surface, and that a higher proportion of mobile enzyme species on the surface increases the efficiency of cellulase action.
the hydrolysis of crystalline celluloses by cellulase is not only a matter of enzyme-substrate interaction but also of the accessibility of cellulose surface to cellulase molecules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the crystalline cellulase substrate is not an inert surface but rather a dynamic substrate that can influence the activity of the enzymes.
the efficiency of cellulase hydrolysis of crystalline celluloses is strongly affected by the surface mobility of the cellulase molecules.
the crystalline cellulase surface can be modified to enhance cellulose accessibility by cellulase enzymes.
